title: Will Anderson: Contract allows me to bless my family like they've blessed me

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Will Anderson: Contract allows me to bless my family like they've blessed me
sources.description: Texans pass rusher Will Anderson signed a three-year, $150 million contract this week that made him the highest-paid non-quarterback in NFL history, and he says the reason the contract matters to him is that he can now afford to do anything for his family.
